     ```c
     stop = true;;
     ```
     to:
     ```c
     stop = true;
     ```

Both modifications address the same issue of double semicolons, which were introduced in a previous commit. The changes are stylistic improvements aimed at enhancing code readability and maintaining coding standards. They do not affect the functionality of the code but help in preventing potential confusion or misinterpretation by developers reading the code in the future.
